steps.description: Base tables (profiles, core app tables), uuid-ossp, RLS bootstrap.
Document/inspection/marketing tables + their RLS. Sets an initial role CHECK.
Canonical 6-role CHECK (supersedes #2's), 30-day trial column, handle_new_user() trigger.
Operational BTB tables (prep counts, orders, cleaning schedule).
Compliance register, login vault, emergency contacts, handbook, protocols, new-restaurant tasks + RLS.
Widens business_documents.doc_type to cover every expiring document the vault tracks (licenses, insurance, hood/fire, pest, franchise, lease).
Corrects the profiles select/update policies.
Demo-grade. Opens the compliance/admin tables to public RLS so the cookie-authed Between the Buns surface (no Supabase session) can read/write them. NOT production row security — see the file header.
cleaning_logs.done_time + cleaning_logs.week_start + the public ops-photos Storage bucket and its policies (multi-angle cleaning photos).
emergency_contacts.category + phone_2/phone_3/contact_name/email — the category directory (Electrician, Plumber, Grease Trap…) with 3 preferences per entry.
locations + location_members, profiles.location_id, location_id on prep/order/cleaning + the 3 dashboard-counter tables, urgent flag on PAR sheets, fixed-id seed + membership backfill.
corporate_inspections.inspection_type (corporate / in-house / franchisee share one table), backfills legacy inhouse_inspections rows, opens the table to the BTB tablet.
prep_counts.pull — the Freezer pull & Dairy column of the new Daily Prep Sheet. Run last: until it's run the sheet still reads, but Save refuses with a message naming this file.

marketing_promotions.category / size / person_name / location_id — the promotion form's category, size, person and target site. Needs locations from #11; until it's run the marketing board hides those four inputs.

Widens login_vault.category to the Login Vault's flat category list (Debit machine, Internet, MYR POS, Bank login, Uber …) while keeping every legacy bucket readable. Keep in sync with src/lib/vault-categories.ts.
cash_outs — end-of-day till reconciliation (till, cash sale, delivery fees, tips, cash-out, safe drop) with a 30-day retention purge (purge_cash_outs()).
staff_members + staff_shifts — weekly roster calendar (90-day retention on shifts via purge_staff_schedule()). Needs locations from #11.

corporate_dates — filing deadlines, payroll remittances, licences and renewals with optional monthly/quarterly/annual recurrence. location_id IS NULL = company-wide. Kept forever (a purged deadline would silently vanish from next year's view).
training_topics + training_sections — the SOP/onboarding guide (sections are plain text: paragraphs + - checklist lines, published hides drafts from staff). Kept forever.

inventory_items + inventory_counts — the closing count sheet (count_month is a YYYY-MM key, one row per item per month) with value and variance against the previous close. Retention: 24 months via purge_inventory_counts().

branding_requests — signage/menu/uniform/packaging requests on a status board (open → in_review → in_progress → done/declined). Retention: finished requests older than 24 months via purge_branding_requests(); open work is never purged.

Storage buckets cleaning-photos, inspection-photos, training-videos + their policies (upload targets for uploadToSupabase() in src/lib/files.ts). Existing cleaning/inspection photos stay in ops-photos (#9).

inventory_purchases — the daily purchase ledger (GFS invoices + local purchases) that feeds monthly COGS. One source of truth for eligible purchases; unique index blocks duplicate GFS invoice references.

inventory_month_snapshots — server-written month-end accounting snapshot (opening/purchases/closing/sales/COGS/food-cost %). Rows are never deleted; reopening flips status to 'draft' and records who/why so history is preserved.
inventory_audit_log — append-only trail of finalize/reopen/correct actions with a JSONB copy of the figures at action time.
role_page_access — admin-edited role→page matrix the BTB hub reads to decide which cards each role sees. Admin dashboard writes it.

Master inventory list — the 278 items from the owner's workbook seeded once, marked protected, and guarded append-only by a trigger: names may be added, never deleted or renamed. Unit/category/cost stay editable.
13 Nov 2026 updates — branding: qty + combo request items columns; shifts: duty CHECK accepts prep and none (duties optional); compliance: notify reminder toggle column.
Platform admin — app_activity page-visit tracking (powers recently/most used links and the owner heatmap) and platform_plans client billing rows.
Compliance renewals — second attachment slot (other_file_name / other_file_url) beside the renewal certificate.
Separate BTB console credentials, limiter, managed locations and location page allow-lists. Requires the existing BTB location releases.
Transactional person invitations, one-time password setup, existing employee credentials and unioned location page grants.
Console monitoring RPC over managed locations (counts, storage, activity heatmap, recent events, operational health) plus the atomic per-location aggregate storage cap on platform file uploads.
OFF-06 offline replay keys — temperature/prep replay receipts and btb_replay_prep_save. Prerequisite for the page-capabilities release.
Live role/location page grants, read/write browser capabilities, restrictive RLS and checked atomic prep replay. Ordered after step 36 because it wraps btb_replay_prep_save.
Training audience (whole team vs managers only) so Week 4 manager training is reviewed by an owner.
The four-week onboarding programme (Weeks 1-3 staff, Week 4 manager-only), seeded as published training topics and sections.
Managers and supervisors can invite their own team: employee-issued single-use invitations and new staff accounts without a console password.
Unique human-readable location slugs (/btb/drumheller), backfilled from existing names, with slug-aware console create/update functions.
Console super-admin password reset for a locked-out person, without email: salted hash, session revocation and invitation cancellation.
Location time clock: shifts, punches, corrections, manager approval and approved-hours export (btb_platform_time_read and friends).
Location finance: invoices, stock receipts and supplier price history, bank statements and allocations, GST periods and commands.
AI document extraction settings and usage metering. The extractor only prefills the existing review queue.
A branch manager may configure their own location settings (including the AI extraction key); corporate/owner keep organization-wide reach.
Cash-out wastage lines (item, quantity) and staff-meal lines (staff, item, quantity), stored as validated JSON arrays without changing till totals.
Optional photo evidence on an off-form temperature reading.
Per-person daily task assignments (temperature, prep, opening, closing, cleaning) and the clock-out incomplete-task marker for manager approval.
On-site clock-in policy: server-enforced geofence, restaurant network allowlist, device binding and an audit of every attempt.
Sign-in hardening: count failures only, clear on success, throttle per IP, and record every attempt for 30 days.

Branch isolation for the daily tools: temperature standards and order sheets gain a location, and location-aware writers replace the restaurant-wide ones so one branch can never read or change another's temperature log, checklists, order sheet or staff schedule.
Prep sheet workflow: per-branch weekly PAR levels, section assignments, autosaved drafts, submissions with in-app manager notices, comments and 45 days of history.
Field-level audit of prep and order sheet changes (tenant and branch scoped), readable only by owner, supervisor and corporate.
Month-end inventory becomes per branch: legacy rows backfilled to Drumheller, branch-scoped indexes and uniqueness, and a seed helper so a new branch starts with its own copy of the item list.

Cleaning schedule and cash-out move behind server endpoints: branch and week columns on cleaning_logs, one till count per branch per day, and browser writes revoked on cleaning_logs, cash_outs, prep_counts and order_sheets.

Unified auth prerequisites: canonical tenants/principals, linked collision credential archives, safe signup/profile privileges, explicit console assignments, durable login limits and revocable sessions. Legacy ownership is not guessed.

Verified current-location SQL context, atomic session creation/switching, explicit console/employee membership without role bypass, scoped operational writes, and retirement of direct browser data/RPC capabilities. Legacy null ownership remains unresolved.

Repair the console location list: btb_admin_locations() no longer reads a created_at column workspace_console_locations does not have, and lists every location in the console's tenant instead of only the current branch.

Console monitoring covers the whole tenant: the site list, people count, activity heatmap and recent feed all use one tenant-active branch helper instead of a single-branch pin, so locations/active_locations and every per-branch aggregate report the real estate.

A console may act on any branch of its estate: btb_admin_assert_location() keeps the console-session, explicit-assignment, same-tenant and active checks but no longer requires the branch to equal the session's pinned location, which locked every other branch out of people, invitations, passwords and location settings.
